name: email-assistant
description: Personalized daily email and meeting assistance with an orchestrator, user-owned rules in Spaces, and cloud scheduling.

interface.longDescription: Eight skills coordinate daily inbox work, personalized rule changes, authorized triage, Pocket AI meeting reports and historical context, attendee follow-up drafts saved in Outlook, and authorized capture of assigned meeting tasks in Wrike. User-owned settings, rules, reports, and runtime state live in ChatGPT Spaces. The orchestrator manages one authorized cloud controller per mailbox scope. Connected apps and a verified cloud pilot are required. Never sends email.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up and manage my daily email assistant.
Update my inbox rules and show what will change.
Show drafts, follow-ups, and meeting outcomes that need my attention.
